read_model: HealthObservationService aggregates real source observations; liveness is independent from queue depth.
invariants: Queue table exists does not imply alive worker
Refresh is not a durable diagnostic run

epistemic.empty: Successful observed queue count 0 is available-empty, not disconnected.
epistemic.stale: Age exceeds source freshness budget: show value and age as stale.
epistemic.unavailable: Source unreachable/permission denied is unavailable with recovery path.
epistemic.error: Fetch/parse error preserves safe correlation ID and last observation.
